title: 進路セミナーⅡ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar II
keywords: Corporate research about cooperation 2.Information collection and activities 3.Interview role play 4.Campus procedures for job hunting 5.Information society
educationalGoal: The goal of this course is to help students determine their course of future employment or graduate school, and to prepare them for working on their own. The course covers two primary topics:1. Helping students learn the attitudes and approach from career selection to decision. 2. Motivating students to learn the contents and standards of the type of job or graduate school they have selected, ensure they have the necessary aptitude, scholastic ability, education, etc.
advice: In this course, students will cover the following items: 1. Guidance on employment and graduate school 2. Employment practice examination (general education, general aptitude, and specialty) 3. Use of employment notes named “FUTURE” 4. Resume, motivation writing method, and self-appeal method 5. Career-related procedures, document entry methods 6. Attitudes towards individual/group interviews
requiredKnowledge: Career Planning Seminars I and II, which are held in the first and second semesters, are lectures covering career activities in the next fiscal year. They are held to prepare students to take necessary measures, make preparations for severe employment conditions, and/or for going on to graduate school. All students are required to take these courses -regardless of their future advancement or employment prospects -as preparation for career planning, employment, and advancement.

activityGoals.body: Be able to use the information necessary for going on to higher education and/or job hunting.
Be able to study the content and level of aptitude, scholastic ability, etc.required by the type of job.

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to self-manage, self-develop, and set clear goals for future courses, and make voluntary effort to achieve them.
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to develop some clear goals towards future career paths, and have the will to make voluntary efforts to achieve them.

lessons.content: ・Guidance of Career Seminar II, review of Career Seminar I ・Corporate research ・Basic knowledge about work and companies ・Collection of company information Company information search service ・Company information sheet ・Companies employing media informatics students ・How to write self-appeal documents Summary of self-analysis, self-appeal sheet, resume, self-introduction, entry sheet ・How to write a self-introduction Motivation, focus on non-study, features and strengths
lessons.operation: ・Lectures, exercises, Q&A ・Use the employment notes and career development center website ・Use the corporate information sheet format on the Career Development Center website. ・How to write a self-introduction Use submission format on LC Portal ・Self-check
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・Read the employment notes (summary of self-analysis, self-appeal sheet, resume, self-introduction, entry sheet) to understand the outline. Review: ・Review of lecture ・Company search Report description: ・Description of company information sheet Complete one company information sheet. ・Complete employment notes (summary of self-analysis, self-appeal sheet, resume, self-introduction) Report description: ・Complete the “self-introduction sheet” (LC portal submission format).

lessons.content: ・Practice test 1 Common sense test SPI test(language part)
lessons.assignments: Review: ・Comprehensive self-evaluation of test results and take measures to improve ability.
Review: ・Understand company work and consider own's role in the company.

lessons.content: ・Practice test 2 SPI test(non language part) Programmer aptitude test
lessons.assignments: Review: ・Comprehensive self-evaluation of test results and take measures to improve ability.

lessons.content: ・Employment overview by an external lecturer. Information industry research and job hunting for the next year.
